entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom@8.1.0
entries.content:
Bloom 8.1.0 moves agent avatars and editors to a single shared renderer, replacing the legacy WASM/SVG engines.

- Share rendering resources and load geometry and motion assets on demand while keeping each avatar's animation, gaze, reactions and computer activity independent.
- Preview shapes and eyes separately, keep color controls available, and preserve complete custom configurations independently of presets.
- Bound body pigment in the engine and match hands and fitted tufts to the avatar color.
- Improve accessory fitting and restore Felipe's authored beret placement and material.
- Update the Todd, Alfred, Iris and Felipe creation templates and versioned avatar documentation.

Validation includes 34 integration tests, 32 runtime regressions, package/export verification, consumer types, and browser checks for editors and the Website integration. The main merge additionally requires the full nine-shard CI suite.

When upgrading from 7.x, note the 8.0.0 change: import `LinkPreviewCard` and its types from `@oxy.so/bloom/link-preview`. The card supports image renditions through `expo-image`.

entries.title: TNP Client v0.4.0
entries.content:
**Install (one command):**
```bash
# macOS / Linux
curl -fsSL https://get.tnp.network | sh

# Windows (PowerShell)
irm https://get.tnp.network/ps | iex
```

**Verify a download yourself:** `SHA256SUMS.sig` is the raw 64-byte
Ed25519 signature over `SHA256SUMS` by the TNP release key
`n4CCDVyVmPikeULWtYh6ohrhAPvd4n9CvhdDgwVSRjw=` — procedure in
`docs/architecture/security.md` §7. Build provenance:
`gh attestation verify <file> --repo OxyHQ/tnp`.

**Platforms:** linux-x64, linux-arm64, darwin-x64, darwin-arm64, windows-x64

* release(api): serve the signed client 0.3.0 by @NateIsern in https://github.com/OxyHQ/tnp/pull/97
* fix(web): install page forwards only .ox to the TNP resolver by @NateIsern in https://github.com/OxyHQ/tnp/pull/96
* security: transport v1 cutover — domain-key trust, authenticated service nodes, one relay core by @NateIsern in https://github.com/OxyHQ/tnp/pull/98
* feat: end-to-end encrypted personal DNS rules (block/redirect) with router export by @NateIsern in https://github.com/OxyHQ/tnp/pull/99
* release(client): 0.4.0 — transport v1 and personal DNS rules by @NateIsern in https://github.com/OxyHQ/tnp/pull/100

entries.title: Bloom 7.32.0
entries.content:
The agent avatar's 3D characters now share one renderer, and their parts are interchangeable. (#262)

- **Shared renderer:** every avatar on a page draws through one WebGL context with shared programs, textures and scene preparation, so a page of 48 avatars no longer needs 48 contexts. Native character controllers stay resident across React and Work transitions.
- **Clippo** is a new character preset, and a **single-eye (Cyclops)** option joins the eye styles.
- **Interchangeable parts:** any shape can take any preset's eyes, eyewear and accessory (Todd's eyes and Felipe's headwear included); each shape owns its eye layout, and parts and reactions no longer depend on the preset.
- **Editor:** unified shape customisation in the agent creator, with selector artwork for Clippo, Todd and the single eye. Their `<Svg>`s use `svgA11yProps()`, as every other `<Svg>` has since 7.31.1.

entries.title: Bloom 7.31.1
entries.content: An `<Svg>` no longer writes React Native's accessibility props to the DOM. On web, react-native-svg spread `accessible` (and Image's `accessibilityRole`/`accessibilityLabel`) onto the `<svg>` element, so React logged "Received `false` for a non-boolean attribute `accessible`" wherever a shaped avatar was drawn, and a named shape image never reached the web accessibility tree. Web now gets `role="img"` + `aria-label` or `aria-hidden`; native is unchanged. (#315)

entries.title: Bloom 7.31.0
entries.content: Adds `@oxy.so/bloom/video-view`: expo-video's `VideoView` with `playsInline` on by default, so web videos play inline on iPhone Safari instead of showing only their poster. `MediaSurface` (and the media flight layer, hosts and gallery) now render their video arm through it. (#299)

entries.title: Bloom 7.30.1
entries.content:
Fixes excess native height for intrinsically sized buttons in wrapped rows. React Native compatibility-mode Yoga could report 568dp around three 40dp rows; the corrected fixture measures 136dp including gaps. The host now stretches its persistent content horizontally from a column layout, preserving caller slot direction, justification, alignment and loading identity.

Validation: 17 rendered-tree layout cases against the actual Yoga engines shipped with RN 0.83.2 and RN 0.85.3, including an old-layout negative control, RTL, fractional/narrow widths and full-size row/column/reverse layouts. 225 other focused tests, 16 Chromium cases, source/consumer types, build/package/freshness checks and full PR/merge-group CI pass. Physical-device acceptance belongs to the consumer after official installation.

No API or peer changes; Services 11.1.16 remains compatible. The existing upstream dynamic color-mix serialization limitation is unchanged (nativewind/nativewind#1870, nativewind/react-native-css#464); no dependency patch or fork is shipped.

entries.title: Services 11.1.16
entries.content:
Compatibility patch for official Bloom 7.30 interactive video overlays. Extends the existing 7.13+ supported peer line to <7.31, preserving earlier supported lines and all maintenance runtime source.

Verified one official Bloom resolution, TypeScript, 113 suites / 1040 tests, a fresh build and every packed export. Main-line compatibility also passes types and 114 suites / 1042 tests (OxyHQ/oxy#1626).

The NativeWind/CSS pairing and its separately tracked upstream color-mix serialization limitation remain unchanged.

entries.title: Bloom 7.30.0
entries.content:
Adds `ZoomableMediaGallery.renderVideoOverlay(media)` for consumer-owned error, loading and retry UI over the active video. The current callback updates after opening; inactive pages, images and closed viewers do not render the slot. Interactive children live outside the dismiss/zoom gesture tree, preserve the existing player, and fade with the viewer.

Validation: 13 focused suites / 199 tests; four Chromium touch/mouse/keyboard and reduced-motion overlay cases; seven existing lifecycle browser cases; source and consumer types; clean build, packaged exports and freshness checks; complete PR/merge-group CI.

`open()` captures its media list. A retry that replaces the player must dismiss/unmount the old viewer before releasing that player; it can return to inline playback and open the replacement session explicitly.

Default presentation and player ownership remain unchanged. The official NativeWind/CSS RC pair is unchanged. The separately tracked upstream dynamic color-mix serialization limitation remains (nativewind/nativewind#1870 and nativewind/react-native-css#464); no dependency patch or fork is shipped.

entries.title: @oxy.so/services 11.1.15
entries.content:
Compatibility patch for the official Bloom 7.29 viewer lifecycle release. Extends the existing 7.13+ peer line to <7.30 while preserving earlier supported lines, the NativeWind 5.0.0-rc.0 / react-native-css 3.1.0-rc.0 pair and all maintenance runtime source.

Validated TypeScript, 113 suites / 1040 tests, a fresh build and every packed export against a single official Bloom runtime. The main-line forward port is OxyHQ/oxy#1624 (114 suites / 1042 tests plus types).

This patch does not alter the upstream CSS compiler/runtime; its known dynamic color-mix serialization limitation remains documented in the Bloom 7.29 release notes.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom 7.29.0
entries.content:
Adds optional `ZoomableMediaGallery.onOpenChange`: one accepted-opening event, then one event after dismissal finishes or the open viewer unmounts. Callbacks stay current across renders and duplicate open/close requests do not emit duplicates. Consumers retain ownership of video players and can transfer playback between inline and fullscreen views.

Validation: 13 focused suites / 197 tests, seven real Chromium lifecycle cases, source and consumer TypeScript, fresh build/export/freshness checks, and complete PR plus merge-group CI.

The official NativeWind 5.0.0-rc.0 / react-native-css 3.1.0-rc.0 pairing remains unchanged. Documentation clarifies that custom type-scale line heights should use standard unitless ratios: pixel-valued var() fallbacks still have an upstream native limitation. A separate upstream dynamic color-mix serialization issue also remains (nativewind/nativewind#1870, nativewind/react-native-css#464); this release does not claim to fix or patch that dependency.

entries.title: @oxy.so/services@11.1.14
entries.content:
Admit Bloom 7.28 and the official react-native-css 3.1.0-rc.0 / NativeWind 5.0.0-rc.0 pair with a single CSS runtime. Preserve existing supported Bloom lines and framework peer ranges; maintenance runtime source is unchanged.

Validated types and 113 suites / 1,040 tests with the official Bloom package. Candidate also passed types/tests/build and all packed exports under Expo 56.0.23 / React Native 0.85.3, and types/tests under the baseline SDK57 catalog.

For typography tokens use standard unitless line-height ratios. The compiler still has an upstream limitation for pixel-valued var fallbacks; see Bloom 7.28 release notes.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom@7.28.0
entries.content:
Fix native pixel line heights by adopting the official react-native-css 3.1.0-rc.0 compiler and matching NativeWind 5.0.0-rc.0. An 18px font with a 20px line now remains 20px instead of multiplying to 360px. Preserve native instance refs at styled boundaries and the public third-party image adapter.

NativeWind consumers must use the matching compiler pair and one CSS runtime. Existing Bloom typography ratios and default component appearance remain unchanged.

Validated: complete PR and merge-group CI; native compiler/runtime metrics, geometry and image-adapter regressions; browser scope, portal, toast and focus checks; Services types/tests/build/packed exports under Expo 56.0.23 and React Native 0.85.3.

Known upstream limitation: Tailwind font utilities with a pixel-valued `var(--tw-leading, 20px)` fallback still multiply that fallback on native. This release fixes literal pixel declarations and direct static variables, not that fallback case. Define type-scale line-height tokens as standard unitless CSS ratios, as Bloom already does, and verify the intended rendered metrics on both platforms.



### Additional upstream limitation verified after release

Dynamic `color-mix()` declarations with omitted weights still fail after Metro serializes the stylesheet: an absent weight becomes `null` and the RC runtime drops the color. Static/inlined color mixes are corrected, but that does not establish dynamic-color correctness on device. Tracked upstream in nativewind/nativewind#1870 and nativewind/react-native-css#464; no patched dependency is shipped by Bloom.

entries.title: @oxy.so/services 11.1.13
entries.content:
Services 11.1 maintenance now admits Bloom 7.27 exact local color scopes and portal propagation. The peer cap is <7.28.0; prior supported lines and runtime source are unchanged.

Verified with a single official Bloom7.27.0 resolution: types,113 suites/1040 tests, build and all33 packed export targets. The release tarball is built and packed together with Bun. Main compatibility is forward-ported separately.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom 7.27.0
entries.content:
BloomColorScope now supports exact canonical token overrides and a local light/dark mode. CSS aliases, native variables and JavaScript theme consumers share these values, including portaled content. Updating or clearing scope values preserves descendant state and does not change application preferences or global theme classes. Local mode does not redefine consumer dark selectors.

Validation: 590 tests across 29 focused suites, 4 real Chromium scope/nested-dialog cases and all 19 prior modal focus scenarios; source and consumer types, package exports and build freshness. Oxy Services maintenance and main compatibility passed 1040 and 1042 tests respectively against the candidate. Full CI and merge queue required before publication.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom 7.26.2
entries.content:
Fix a preexisting modal focus race when dismissal starts before the entry autofocus frame. Exiting dialogs no longer refocus their content or trap Tab after restoring focus to the opener.

Validated with deterministic nested-dialog tests, real Chromium center/side/bottom dialogs in normal and reduced motion, existing pending-action and empty chat-panel regressions, source and consumer types, and package export verification. Native behavior and public APIs are unchanged.

Also includes the separately reviewed touch-browser scrolling correction from #306: horizontal swipe surfaces allow vertical browser panning.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom 7.26.1
entries.content:
Fix keyboard focus retention when every control in a modal is temporarily unavailable. Tab and Shift+Tab now focus the panel without scrolling; traversal resumes correctly when actions become available.

Applies to shared web modal keyboard handling, including centered dialogs, side sheets and bottom sheets. AI chat drawers explicitly support programmatic panel focus and use it when navigation is empty. No API or native behavior change.

Verified with real Chromium pending-action and focus-restoration scenarios, focused modal/overlay regression suites, source and consumer types, package verification, and full CI/merge queue.

entries.title: @oxy.so/services 11.1.12
entries.content:
Services 11.1 maintenance now admits Bloom 7.26, including the radio-chip group API. The Bloom peer cap is <7.27.0; previous supported lines and the runtime source remain unchanged.

Verified against official @oxy.so/bloom 7.26.0: types, 113 test suites / 1040 tests, a single resolved Bloom runtime, and build/package verification of all 33 export targets. The release tarball was built and packed together with Bun.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom 7.26.0
entries.content:
Adds RadioChip and RadioGroup variant="chip" with shared selection, disabled constraints, RTL roving focus, Home/End and Space. Chips support standard sizes, neutral tone, selected appearance and wrapping layout.

Adds class recipes for radio option and string-label styling, preserving row/card defaults and rich composition. Web radio hosts allow layered caller CSS to own layout and typography; native retains styled primitives.

Verified with focused native CSS/component and ARIA/Field contract tests, 16 real Chromium scenarios, source/external typechecks, package/build checks and CI.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom 7.24.1
entries.content:
Fixes the first RatingInput pointer press being lost when hover changes the decorative star. Radios retain their accessible names and selection behavior across mouse, touch and keyboard.

FileUpload now excludes inactive and fading status lines from assistive technology while retaining their visual transitions. No public API or visual default changes.

Validated with 210 focused component tests, source and external consumer typechecks, real Chromium mouse/touch and accessibility regressions, build/package checks and required repository CI.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom@7.24.0
entries.content:
Cards now use 20px circular corners by default. Panels, menus and sheets also use circular corners, and text fields, textareas, tag fields and input groups share the 12px field radius.

Explicit radius values, resolved style radii, smooth corner overrides and scoped panel geometry remain supported.

Validated with package and consumer type checks, the complete CI suite, and Chromium geometry and painted-corner checks.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom 7.23.2
entries.content:
- Keep Button accessible names available during loading, including composed labels and icon-only controls with explicit labels.
- Preserve child identity, dimensions and class-driven layout while hiding label paint with opacity.
- Keep disabled/loading links semantically named without enabling navigation, and treat the native loading spinner as decorative.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom 7.23.1
entries.content:
- Preserve the first click on app controls while a web toast stack is expanded.
- Observe outside pointer presses without a transparent click-intercepting layer; retain toast actions, swipe, and native outside-tap collapse.
- Add real browser regressions for long-page scrolling, mouse/touch, reduced motion, and toast dismissal.

entries.title: @oxy.so/services 11.1.10
entries.content:
Adds compatibility with Bloom 7.23.0, including grouped Carousel navigation.

Maintenance runtime source remains unchanged from 11.1.0. Services typecheck and all 1,040 tests pass against the official Bloom release. Built and verified package exports before publication.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom 7.23.0
entries.content:
- Add Carousel slidesPerGroup for anchored arrow and keyboard navigation, preserving individual dots and swipe stops.
- Normalize group sizes and retain fractional geometry, RTL, short final groups and boundary looping.
- Preserve accepted controlled destinations when browser scroll rounding follows list changes.

entries.title: @oxy.so/services 11.1.9
entries.content:
Services 11.1.9 verifies compatibility with Bloom 7.22.0 and admits its rich RadioGroup composition and public Collapsible APIs. The maintenance runtime source is unchanged.

Validation: TypeScript, 113 suites / 1040 tests, package build, and all 39 exported targets verified in the published artifact. Mercaria verifies purchase-plan selection, portaled Select dismissal, Accordion visibility, responsive sheets and focus restoration with one Bloom runtime.

Published tarball SHA1: `b27edbdf821b8d18fd631ac709cd9ebb82393e48`.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom 7.22.0
entries.content:
- Compose RadioGroup options using decorative labels, owned controls and stable focus refs.
- Add controlled Collapsible with measured height, live reduced motion, preserved children and conditional focus return.
- Share the measured frame with Accordion while preserving its existing disclosure defaults.
- Close nested Select popups when their logical body hides without resetting their value.

entries.title: @oxy.so/services 11.1.8
entries.content:
Services 11.1.8 verifies compatibility with Bloom 7.21.0 and admits its additive Dialog/BottomSheet backdrop and transition APIs. The maintenance runtime source is unchanged.

Validation: TypeScript, 113 suites / 1040 tests, package build, and all 39 exported targets verified in the published artifact.

Published tarball SHA1: `fd4373379fdcb8d7fe4b50f916fc72875e1a91fa`.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom 7.21.0
entries.content:
Add optional backdrop appearance and timed presentation to Dialog and BottomSheet. Backdrop supports logical linear gradients and zero blur while retaining its dismissal and layering ownership. Surface transitions share panel/backdrop timing and exit lifetime, honor live reduced motion, and preserve existing defaults when omitted.

Includes explicit validation/clamping, native and web coverage, 24 Chromium geometry/paint/motion/focus scenarios, and updated documentation.

entries.title: @oxy.so/services@11.1.7
entries.content:
Adds compatibility with Bloom 7.20 while preserving the 11.1 maintenance source and all existing supported peer lines. Consumers can use one Bloom instance for Services and their app.

Validation: TypeScript and all 1,040 tests pass against official Bloom 7.20.0. Build and pack ran together; all 33 export targets resolve, 2,084 compiled files are included, and no workspace/catalog/file dependency protocols remain in the tarball.

Tarball SHA1: `a1749503c4fd2721f601453ce45a64a391601d6a`.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom 7.20.0
entries.content:
- Add Meter/RatingBar visual reveal with configurable delay, duration, easing and once behavior; accessible values stay real throughout. Reduced motion settles immediately on both platforms.
- Add ViewportProvider, useViewportBinding and useInView for real web/native visibility, nested clipping and event-driven native measurement without polling.
- Add Dialog.minSideGutter (default 24); zero permits full-width side sheets while preserving logical placement and insets.

See the viewport, stat-bar, rating and dialog guides for composition and platform contracts.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom 7.19.2
entries.content:
Fix web Popover focus return after Escape or actions inside the panel. The trigger regains focus without scrolling, including conditionally mounted content. Deliberate focus transfers to other controls are preserved. Native sheet behavior and placement semantics are unchanged.

Validated with nested-dialog keyboard tests, real Chromium in normal and reduced motion, source/consumer types, package verification and the full CI/merge queue.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom 7.19.1
entries.content:
Fix Button dropping aria-current from navigation links. The standard ARIA values now reach web button/anchor/asChild hosts; inherited child values are preserved unless overridden. Native announces the equivalent selected trait while retaining an explicit pressed toggle state.

Validated by 144 native/web Button tests, source/consumer typechecks, Chromium current-link navigation at mobile/desktop widths, clean package/freshness verification and required CI/merge queue.

entries.title: @oxy.so/services 11.1.6
entries.content:
Adds compatibility with Bloom 7.18 and 7.19 while preserving the existing 11.1 maintenance source and supported older peer lines. Consumers can use one Bloom instance for Services and their app.

Validation: TypeScript and all 1,040 tests pass separately against both official Bloom releases. Build and pack ran together; all exports resolve, 2,084 compiled files are included, and no workspace/catalog protocols remain in the tarball.

Tarball SHA1: `35f0a14dd99c9389eef4429beb43dc687c3ea8ac`.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom 7.19.0
entries.content:
- Carousel can place its existing controls beside footer content, customize logical overlay offsets, and wrap controls/track keyboard navigation without cloned slides.
- Search exposes icon and clear-control geometry. The clear control participates in field layout and honors disabled Field/InputGroup constraints without overwriting caller input styles.
- Dialog, BottomSheet and PopoverContent support opt-in flat material while preserving the default surface optics. Flat navigation headers publish/use the panel backing.
- RadioGroup supports whole-option styles and web roving focus with RTL arrow navigation, disabled-option skipping, Home/End and wrapping.
- TextField preserves an explicitly authored accessible name inside Field.

Validated with source/consumer typechecks, native/web regression suites, actual Chromium layout/keyboard/paint checks, package exports/freshness verification, and required CI/merge queue.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom 7.18.0
entries.content:
Composed labels and follow button recipes

- Checkbox and Radio accept decorative labelContent layouts with explicit accessible names and preserve their existing full-row hit targets.
- FollowButton exposes appearance, material and className on its Button, plus labelClassName on both animated labels and their measuring copies. Standard defaults and loading identity remain unchanged.
- Checkbox and Radio now activate with Space on web, including repeat and blur cancellation handling; existing Enter and native interaction remain intact.

Validated with component/DOM/native CSS compiler tests, architecture guards, source and consumer typechecks, real Chromium light/dark/RTL/reduced-motion scenarios, clean package build and mandatory CI/merge-queue checks.

entries.title: @oxy.so/services 11.1.5
entries.content:
Adds support for Bloom 7.17 while preserving the existing supported peer lines. Services source is unchanged from the 11.1 maintenance baseline.

Validated against the official Bloom 7.17.0 package: TypeScript, 1,040 tests across 113 suites, both lockfile sync checks, and a fresh build and pack. The artifact contains 2,418 files (2,084 under lib), with all export targets present.

Tarball SHA1: `afd1be5912dbd72f6e63ac5e93f3f93bd05a5f78`.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom 7.17.0
entries.content:
Carousel now accepts visual arrowButtonProps and can hide unavailable arrows without shifting their slots. Keyboard focus moves to the track if its focused arrow becomes unavailable.

Search and TextField expose separate layout and surface classes with native CSS resolution and web cascade authority, preserving defaults and field states. Search container slots include its clear control.

Modal focus restoration now waits for the opener's actual inert boundary release. Accordion no longer forwards the native collapsable prop to its DOM panel.

Validated with source/consumer types, package/export/freshness checks, native compiler and component tests, and Chromium coverage across themes, directions, pointer modes, reduced motion and conditional dialog unmount.

entries.title: @oxy.so/services 11.1.4
entries.content:
Adds support for Bloom 7.16 while preserving the existing supported peer lines. Services source is unchanged from the 11.1 maintenance baseline.

Validated against the official Bloom 7.16.1 package: TypeScript, 1,040 tests across 113 suites, both lockfile sync checks, and a fresh build and pack. The published artifact contains 2,418 files (2,084 under lib) and all 33 export targets resolve.

Tarball SHA1: `8f98ffdf58d4e5edf3fb42013c4a060a3b63e419`.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom 7.16.1
entries.content:
Fix Dialog scrollable=false on side drawers with headers: the child owns one bounded scroll viewport, without a disabled outer ScrollView. Native centered and headerless side placements now propagate the same contract.

Initial modal focus stays on a control within the panel viewport, falling back to the panel, and preserves scroll position. Long paginated lists therefore open and reopen at their intended position. Explicit content focus and keyboard traversal remain intact.

Validated with 66 Dialog/keyboard tests, 57 guards, source/consumer types, build/package/freshness, and 15 real Chromium layout, scrolling, footer and pagination-reopen cases.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom 7.16.0
entries.content:
Accordion now links triggers and regions, makes closed content inert and hidden from accessibility, restores focus when controlled collapse hides an active field, and honors live reduced-motion changes. New className slots customize each host and the measured body. An optional timed Bézier transition preserves the existing springs by default.

Rating adds showValue and starSize for standalone glyph summaries. RatingBar exposes row, label, display, track and fill classes; Meter owns track/fill styling while value/max owns the fraction. Defaults remain unchanged across web and native.

Validated with real Chromium light/dark, keyboard, accessibility, RTL and motion cases; native class resolution; component regressions; typechecks; package and freshness checks; and the complete CI suite.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom 7.15.0
entries.content:
Button did not expose focus, hover or keyboard events, so consumers could not select a gallery thumbnail on focus, navigate between refs with arrow keys, or preview an option under the pointer using its public contract.

Add optional onFocus/onBlur and onHoverIn/onHoverOut handlers to both forks, plus DOM onKeyDown/onKeyUp handlers on web. ButtonFocusEvent and ButtonHoverEvent retain the original platform event types. Buttons, href anchors and asChild compose caller/child handlers with the existing press lifecycle; preventing a keyboard default prevents a new press preview, while key-up/blur still clean up. Touch does not synthesize web hover, and disabled/loading controls suppress hover entry while exit can clear a preview. Existing styling and loading identity remain unchanged.

Validation: 168 focused tests across six suites, including native event forwarding, existing interaction paint, all web host forms, keyboard cancellation, long-press cleanup and className/loading regressions. Eight real Chromium cases cover focus selection without activation, arrow navigation through forwarded refs, asChild composition, Enter activation and mouse/touch hover across themes and reduced-motion modes. Types, consumer typecheck, build, package verification and build-freshness pass; component docs updated and adoption matrix regenerated. Version 7.15.0 for the added public API.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom 7.14.3
entries.content:
Fix Button className authority on web and native. Consumer classes control supplied geometry, typography, fills, shadows and state styles while unclaimed defaults remain unchanged. Native built-in labels, glyphs and spinners inherit resolved class colors. Loading retains mounted content. No new props.

Validation: 164 focused checks including actual native CSS compiler/resolver tests; 16 Chromium scenarios covering themes, pointer types, motion preferences, component-layer recipes, default parity and persistent loading content. Types, build, consumer typecheck and package verification pass.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom 7.14.2
entries.content:
Fix outlined Stepper value geometry: reserve 44.8px for medium and 39.2px for small independently of digit typography. The medium capsule is 102.8px wide.

Verified 24 Stepper checks (web and native), 16 Chromium combinations of direction/theme/pointer/motion, actual capsule widths, expanded hit targets, bounds, keyboard and removal. Build, package and consumer typechecks pass.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom 7.14.1
entries.content:
Button now preserves mounted child state when loading starts and finishes, so animated labels and stateful content do not restart. Existing geometry and loading interaction semantics are retained on web and native.

Verified with 131 focused assertions, real Chromium identity/geometry tests across themes, viewport sizes and motion settings, package/type checks and complete CI.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom 7.14.0
entries.content:
Stepper and StepperRow now support appearance="outline": a theme-colored quantity capsule with plain decrement/increment actions, expanded touch targets and reduced-motion-aware hover/press feedback. The default separate controls and all existing value, keyboard, accessibility, boundary and removal behavior are preserved.

Verified with rendered DOM and native action tests, real Chromium across themes, directions, pointer types and motion preferences, package/type checks and the complete CI suite.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom 7.13.1
entries.content:
Bottom sheets on web now expose the actual panel as a modal dialog, including sticky navigation controls and scrolling content. Dialog forwards its accessible name and description to this panel; native presentation is unchanged.

Verified with rendered DOM assertions, real Chromium keyboard and responsive-placement checks, TypeScript, packaging checks and the complete CI suite.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom 7.13.0
entries.content:
Adds `Carousel arrowsVisibility="hover"`, preserving `always` as the default. On fine-pointer, hover-capable web browsers, arrows fade in on carousel hover or focus within; touch/coarse-pointer browsers and native keep arrows visible. Reduced motion removes the fade. Works with header/overlay placement, controlled selection and existing `showArrows` breakpoints.

Validated with 62 focused Carousel/ListingDetails/adoption checks, TypeScript and consumer/package gates, 16 actual Chromium combinations of theme, placement, input capability and motion, and the existing RTL/controlled-scroll/layout browser regressions. Full PR and merge queue CI must pass before publication. No physical-device run is claimed.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom 7.12.0
entries.content:
Adds `Button material="flat"` for exact semantic or branded fills without sheen, rim, refraction or material shadow. The default remains `surface`, including existing loading, disabled and focus behavior.

Adds `ZoomableMediaGallery appearance="page"` for an opaque theme background with matching controls, captions and indicators. The existing `overlay` appearance remains default. `onIndexChange(index)` reports the opening index and actual page changes, so underlying galleries retain the selection after dismissal.

Validated with native/web unit contracts, full package/consumer type checks, complete CI and merge-queue gates, and Chromium pixel, focus, pointer/keyboard navigation and index synchronization checks in both themes and motion preferences. Physical device gestures are not claimed.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom 7.11.0
entries.content:
Adds optional controlled Carousel selection with `index` and `onIndexChange` for thumbnail-driven galleries and variant changes. Indexes refer to child slides and clamp safely when lists change. The existing uncontrolled API remains compatible.

Controlled selection reconciles resize, keyed reordering and replacement, aligns with shared scroll stops, respects reduced motion and native/web RTL coordinates, and prevents programmatic scroll feedback. Initial hidden or unmeasured geometry no longer announces a premature last slide.

Validated with Carousel and ListingPhotoGrid regression tests, actual Chromium thumbnail/arrow/wheel navigation in LTR/RTL and both motion preferences, list/resize cases, package checks, consumer types and the complete CI/merge queue gates. Native coordinate and gesture contracts are unit-tested; physical device validation is not claimed.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom@7.10.0
entries.content:
Carousel now accepts arrowsPlacement="header" | "overlay", defaulting to its existing header controls. Overlay controls are vertically centered at the track edges without reserving an extra row, and empty overlay space passes pointer interaction through to slides. Use showArrows with the app’s own breakpoint for responsive visibility.

RTL navigation now normalizes web, Android and iOS scroll offsets and native snap coordinates. Both placements preserve accessible names, endpoint disabled states and reduced-motion behavior.

Validation:13 carousel tests including native offset contracts; Chromium pointer/geometry checks in LTR/RTL, reduced-motion scroll behavior, responsive controls and slide click-through; build, package freshness, consumer types; complete PR and merge-queue CI. Native behavior is covered by source-derived contract tests, not device interaction.

Changes: https://github.com/OxyHQ/Bloom/pull/275

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom@7.9.2
entries.content:
Custom Avatar SVG placeholders now paint above the shape background on web. Avatar owns the foreground container, so caller icons no longer require positioning styles to remain visible. Initials and image fallbacks retain their existing behavior.

Validation:55 avatar tests; actual Chromium pixel checks for circle and squircle shapes, including a negative control that restores the missing-icon bug; build, package freshness and consumer types; full CI and merge queue.

Changes: https://github.com/OxyHQ/Bloom/pull/274

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom@7.9.1
entries.content:
Composers now remeasure their text when the editable column changes width. A placeholder or draft initially measured in a narrow document footer can shrink after layout without requiring another edit. Height-only observer deliveries are ignored, and typing retains the existing insertion fast path.

ChatComposer minLines/maxLines now follow inputStyle.lineHeight instead of always assuming20px.

Validation:97 focused composer/autosize tests; actual Chromium width-change, custom-line-cap and pointer-selection regressions; build, package export/freshness and consumer-type checks; full CI and merge queue.

Changes: https://github.com/OxyHQ/Bloom/pull/273

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom@7.9.0
entries.content:
- Add Sidebar `railLabels`, `railSelection` and `railWidth` for accessible icon-only navigation with layout width owned by Bloom. Defaults retain existing labeled rails and selected pills.
- Restore browser tooltips on collapsed sidebar controls; react-native-web previously discarded their `title` props.
- Add `AiChatUserMessage bubbleStyle`, including a callback receiving actual column width. Its default end-edge spacing now mirrors in RTL.
- Add ChatComposer `barStyle`, `inputStyle` and `sendIcon` on the actual editable surface and action, preserving shared focus, labels and submission behavior.

Verified with build/package/freshness checks, library and consumer typechecks, regression tests and real Chromium checks of navigation width, accessible destinations, RTL bubble layout and composer surface/typography. Native touch behavior has not been verified on a device in this release task.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom@7.8.0
entries.content:
- Add `PageFooter position="document"` to keep floating controls aligned with their actual content column while the web document scrolls. Bloom owns responsive/RTL placement and continues publishing measured footer clearance.
- Render a disabled send control when ChatComposer has no recording callbacks and no sendable draft. `canSend` retains submission semantics.
- Preserve composer input focus during mouse selection of suggestions; native suggestion lists accept handled taps while the keyboard is open.
- Include live split-pane visibility animation from #270.

Verified with package/build freshness checks, library and consumer typechecks, focused regression suites, and real Chromium tests for pointer selection, focus dismissal, document scrolling, column resizing and mirrored layouts. Native absolute placement has unit coverage; native touch behavior has not been verified on a device in this release task.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom@7.7.1
entries.content:
Admonition now uses soft semantic status surfaces, readable matching icons, 16px corners and padding, and a 12px icon gap. Tips use a success tint and lightbulb; errors use a forbid icon. The subtle outline has independent opacity, preserving full content contrast and native-safe positioning.

The existing Admonition compound API is unchanged. Rich article headings and blocks can continue to use AdmonitionContent directly.

Validated with native/web component tests, full GitHub CI, type checks, build, tarball export/freshness verification, and the website's desktop/mobile article integration.

entries.title: @oxy.so/services@11.2.0-oxy-one.1
entries.content:
Admit the verified Bloom 7.7 line while preserving support for Bloom 6.2 and 7.1. This keeps Services and applications on the same Bloom provider/theme/font instance when using progressive image galleries.

Core remains pinned to 4.5.0-oxy-one.0 and Contracts to 4.11.0-oxy-one.0. Published under the existing `oxy-one` tag; `latest` is unchanged.

Validated with 114 Services suites / 1042 tests, typecheck, package verification, real consumer browser pixels and production web/native exports, plus complete repository CI and merge-queue checks. The source commit also patches MCP SDK, Sharp and shell-quote advisories; no audit exceptions were added.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom@7.7.0
entries.content:
Open image galleries with the thumbnail already visible, then progressively replace it with the full-resolution image.

- Add optional `previewUri` to image media, reusing the image cache immediately.
- Load the active full image eagerly at high priority, with a short transition; keep the preview if it fails.
- Use previews for inactive pages and thumbnail strips, avoiding downloads of every original.
- Hand off media flights when the destination image is displayed.

Validated with media/gallery regression tests, complete GitHub CI and merge-queue checks, build/types/package verification, real Chromium first-frame/pixel tests under delayed and failed downloads, and Mention production web and native exports.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom@7.6.0
entries.content:
- Add `useAnimatedScrollMetricsBinding({ handler })` for Animated ScrollView and animated virtualized lists. Scroll metrics update on the UI thread while Reanimated composes the existing consumer handler.
- Preserve consumer drag/momentum subscriptions, per-handler context, tab-bar minimization and initial/resize/content-size measurements. The returned handler can also be composed through `useMinimizeOnScroll(binding.onScroll)`.
- Accept an optional ordinary RN `onScroll` observer, such as `restoration.onScroll`, with an internal JS bridge only when supplied.
- Keep ordinary RN `useScrollMetricsBinding` and ScrollArea behavior. Diagnose a processed Reanimated handler passed as a plain callback instead of throwing `onScroll is not a function` on the next scroll.

Validated with focused regression and architecture suites, typecheck/external-consumer checks, build/package/freshness gates and complete CI/merge-queue validation. Regression tests use non-callable handler objects matching Reanimated's runtime contract.

Inbox acceptance passed in light/dark at 320/390/768/1440, including empty/loading states, header scrims, bar minimization, retained drafts and restored scroll position. Consumer typecheck/lint/tests and web/Android exports also passed.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom@7.5.0
entries.content:
- Add `ScrollMetricsProvider` and `ScrollArea` to pair one ordinary React Native scroll owner with surrounding page chrome. Existing virtualized lists can use `useScrollMetricsBinding` without application-side scroll arithmetic.
- ScrollArea resolves viewport and content-container utility classes through Bloom's own interop, with ordinary ScrollView props and ref forwarding.
- Add `PageFooter scrim="auto"`: hide the gradient at the bottom and for short content, fading across `scrollThreshold` (default 20px) of remaining content. The existing default `always` remains unchanged.
- PageHeader's existing automatic scrim follows the same local owner. Measurements update on initial layout, content changes and resize, clamp native overscroll, and remain isolated across panes and modal screen scopes.
- Preserve explicit scrim colors, chrome clearance and safe-area ownership.

Validated with focused component/structural suites, complete CI and merge-queue checks, build/package/types, and real Inbox browser composition in light/dark at mobile and desktop widths. Browser checks cover top/middle/bottom opacity, expanding quoted content, short content and viewport resizing without JS errors or horizontal overflow.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom@7.4.0
entries.content:
- Add `Card radius="panel"` to inherit the shared BloomScope panel radius and circular curve. MailMessage now uses this geometry for both expanded and collapsed cards; inline replies can use the same API.
- Add `ContentPanel appearance="plain"`: keep responsive framing, clipping and height without an opaque backing or edge. Headers and footers inherit the actual enclosing surface fill.
- Remove the unnecessary divider beneath MailThread titles while preserving header spacing.

Validation includes native/web surface inheritance, header/footer scrim paint, scoped radius overrides, message disclosure continuity, build/package/type gates and complete CI with merge-queue verification. Inbox browser acceptance covers mobile and desktop composition before publication.

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom@7.3.0
entries.content:
Bloom 7.3.0 adds local recovery for workspace panes and empty-state data for settings sections.

- AppShellSplitPanes independently catches list, detail and info render errors while keeping healthy panes and shell navigation mounted. Each pane supports localized themed recovery, retry, custom fallback data/rendering and resetKey navigation recovery.
- PanelErrorBoundary exposes the same behavior for other bounded regions. ContentPanel can opt into recovery inside its persistent frame. The provider-free catastrophic ErrorBoundary fallback is unchanged.
- Settings General/Profile sections accept EmptyState props when their rows are empty, preserving headings and section actions.
- Pressable/removable Chip actions are siblings, removing nested buttons. Closing no longer selects the chip, and both actions honor disabled state.

Validation includes Bloom build/package/types and full test shards, real react-native-web action tests, and Inbox browser smoke at widths 320, 390 and 1440 with independent pane failures, retry, navigation reset, mobile bottom navigation and settings empty states.

Changes: https://github.com/OxyHQ/Bloom/pull/264

entries.title: @oxy.so/bloom@7.2.0
entries.content:
Bloom 7.2.0 adds shared layout APIs for responsive workspaces and floating page actions.

- AppShell can own native safe areas, use unrestricted content width, and honor zero gutters for full-screen mobile layouts. Bottom navigation can overlay content with measured clearance.
- New PageFooter, PageFooterProvider, and usePageFooterInset provide floating actions, a matching bottom scrim, and local scroll clearance without navigation feedback.
- Sidebar and ContentPanel share the content panel’s circular corners and 28px default radius, configurable through BloomScope panelRadius. ContentPanel chrome="none" preserves clipping without decorative borders or shadows.
- MailMessage preserves its card surface when collapsed. MailThread spaces message cards consistently and supports messageGap.

Validated with Bloom package/type checks and test shards, plus Inbox browser smoke at widths 320–2560, safe-area inset simulation, and web/Android exports.

Changes: https://github.com/OxyHQ/Bloom/pull/263

entries.content:
Published to npm under the `main` dist-tag (`latest` stays 7.1.4, built from the unmerged `codex/avatar-shared-renderer` branch).

entries.title: Oxy ID v1.0 — self-sovereign civic identity + decentralization
entries.content:
# Oxy ID — self-sovereign civic identity + decentralization

This milestone turns **Commons by Oxy** into a citizen-identity app ("Oxy ID") with cryptographically-owned, verifiable reputation, and lays the foundation for user-run data nodes. The civic engine lives in `oxy-api`; ownership comes from **cryptography** (per-user hash-chained signed records) — Oxy is the fast read copy, the user owns the truth.

Full technical documentation: [`docs/`](./docs/) · chronological detail: [`docs/CHANGELOG.md`](./docs/CHANGELOG.md).

## Identity foundation (F0–F1)
- **`did:web:api.oxy.so:u:<id>`** account-anchored DIDs (custodial ↔ self-sovereign, reversible via `authMethods`).
- **Signed records v2** — a per-subject hash chain (`version/seq/prev/collection/rkey`, `RepoHead` O(1) head, shared `canonicalize`/`signedRecordSigningInput`). `verifyEnvelope` branches self-issued / Oxy-custodial / untrusted.
- **Oxy Trust reputation** — crypto-owned via Oxy-signed attestations; users never self-award.

## Anti-gaming + personhood + credentials (F2–F4)
- **Real-life QR attestation** (HIGH) + **random validator jury** (weighted-reservoir selection, graph/device/IP exclusion, slashing).
- **Proof-of-personhood** — web-of-trust vouches + staking + sybil clustering + random audits + on-device biometric (`evidence = 0.50·vouch + 0.35·real-life + 0.15·biometric`, θ=0.6 → verified tier).
- **Verifiable credentials** — issue / verify-against-current-issuer-VM / revoke.

## Decentralization — user nodes (F5)
- **`@oxyhq/node`** — self-hostable data-node server (signed-record log + blobs, reuses `@oxyhq/core` verification).
- **Oxy↔node**: public signed-log export; background **ingest** that re-verifies every record (signature + owner-DID + chain), **LWW** per `(collection,rkey)`, keeps forks, and **Oxy counter-signs** each ingested record (anti-rewrite witness).
- **Managed vault** — Oxy operates a node for non-technical users (custodial `controller:'oxy'`).
- **Invariant: reads NEVER touch a node** — a node down is stale, never slow.

## Product + SDK
- Clean rename **DNI → "Oxy ID"** everywhere; Commons nav restructured (merged ID landing, scan FAB, 3 tabs).
- App-wide clean UI pass (Apple/World App aesthetic) + redesigned Reputation screen.
- `@oxyhq/core` mixins: `identity`, `civic`, `reputation`, `nodes`. Full Commons UI for all of the above. **i18n en/es at 100% parity.**

## Notes
- npm packages are **not** published in this release (the SDK is consumed in-repo via `workspace:*`; civic/node contracts stay internal until the surface stabilizes).
- Deferred (infra): managed-vault container orchestration; seed personhood verifiers; karma→reputation migration; `REC_SCORING_V2`.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

entries.title: TNP Client v0.1.0
entries.content:
TNP DNS resolver daemon v0.1.0

**Install:**

curl -fsSL https://tnp.network/install.sh | sh

# Windows (PowerShell as Administrator)
